data.summary:
Data scientist with over 10 years of total experience and with 6 years of experience in delivering valuable insights through data analytics and machine learning driven modelling solutions to challenging business problems across Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, Insurance, and CPG domains.
Knowledgeable with machine learning (Supervised Learning and Unsupervised Learning algorithms), NLP using Generative AI with LLM, and Knowledge Graph.
Data Science enthusiasts with excellent communication skills
flexible/quick learners comfortable with variety of platforms – familiar with new age development frameworks.
Devise POCs on Search Engine, Question Answering system (on enterprise data) using both OpenAI and open-sourced based LLM models and deploying them to production. I am good at developing and maintaining code, implementing efficient CI‑CD pipelines, testing new features, and resolving issues promptly. I have consistently delivered high‑quality code with a keen focus on minimizing defects.
 Replace legacy keyword search with a high-recall, low-latency hybrid search engine enhanced with
generative AI capabilities. Solution & Responsibilities:
Built an ETL pipeline to extract content from unstructured files (PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX), preprocess text, generate embeddings using OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002, and index in Elastic Search (vector + BM25). Developed a unified search API using FastAPI, deployed via Azure App Service, and scheduled data refresh
pipelines with Azure Functions.
Implemented reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) to merge results from vector and keyword retrieval. Integrated GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI) for on-the-fly summarization of top retrieved documents to improve result
comprehension and user engagement.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Docker, Elastic Search (BM25 +
Vector), Azure OpenAI (text-embedding-ada-002, GPT-4o).
LLM Technique: Hybrid retrieval with RRF + GPT-4o summarization. Impact:
Used by 3 000+ practitioners; avg. 120 min/week saved per user. GPT-based summaries improved result interpretability and decision-making. Outperformed traditional search in Top-5 and Top-10 Precision metrics; user feedback indicated significant
improvement in relevance and usability.
2) RESPONSIBLE RAG SYSTEM WITH QA, SUMMARIZATION & LANGUAGE GUARDRAILS
 Develop a secure and trustworthy enterprise AI assistant that combines question answering,
summarization, and Responsible AI enforcement using Generative AI.
Solution & Responsibilities:
Designed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline to retrieve relevant enterprise content from Milvus
Vector DB, and generate contextual answers using GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI).
Enabled automatic summarization of top-ranked documents using GPT-4o when users requested a summary or
entered open-ended queries.
Integrated guardrails for Responsible AI using the guardrails-ai library, including: Detection and mitigation of toxicity, bias, and unsafe content Enforced English-only output constraint across all LLM generations Schema validation for summaries and answers to ensure consistency and structure Developed a modular backend with FastAPI, and used PostgreSQL to log user queries, feedback, model
responses, and guardrail violation events.
Implemented continuous monitoring and audit logging for model behavior, used for iterative retriever threshold
tuning and safe prompt refinement.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Milvus, PostgreSQL, Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o), guardrails-ai, Docker, Azure DevOps LLM Techniques:
RAG (Milvus vector search + GPT-4o completion) Generative Summarization (on top-k retrieved chunks) Guardrails for responsible AI enforcement (toxicity filtering, language policy, structured outputs) Multi-turn QA with context-aware prompt chaining
Impact:
Ensured 100% English-only output compliance across diverse input scenarios Filtered or blocked 98.7% of unsafe outputs before user delivery Boosted user trust and adoption, with a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating
3) AGENTIC INSIGHT GENERATOR FOR CLIENT EARNINGS TRANSCRIPTS
 Build an intelligent agentic system that automatically analyzes earnings transcripts (e.g., ManpowerGroup Inc.), extracts high-impact strategic themes, classifies them into actionable consulting areas, and delivers tailored solution insights to clients via email and presentation decks.
Solution & Responsibilities:
Designed a multi-agent workflow using a centralized RAG pipeline to:
Ingest and chunk earnings call transcripts Classify themes into categories of Growth, Cost, or Sustainability using a structured prompt and reasoning chain using GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI)
Project Annexure
For each theme, the system generates:
Theme Name ThemeCategorization based on business impact ThemeBrief (≤ 300 characters) ValidatingFactsfromEarningsTranscript — pulled directly from transcript with citations
Each theme is passed as a semantic query to an internal enterprise solution knowledge base indexed in Milvus
Vector DB, retrieving:
Relevant solution components, prebuilt narratives, and case studies which will help improve the client
performance.
Implemented Guardrails-AI to:
Enforce structured schema for theme response (JSON format) Ensure outputs are in English only Detect hallucinated or unsupported claims from transcripts
Developed automated flows to:
Send customized emails to client stakeholders with insights + solutions Offer an option to auto-generate a client-facing PowerPoint deck for internal/external sales use.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, GPT-4o (Azure OpenAI), Milvus, Haystack framework, CrewAI, guardrails-ai,
PostgreSQL, PowerPoint generation (python-pptx)
LLM Technique:
RAG for solution retrieval
Agentic orchestration of multiple LLM tasks (extraction of theme and theme brief → classification of theme category → retrieval from enterprise solution -> sending email to client -> powerpoint generation)
Structured prompt chaining + validation with Guardrails
Impact:
Reduced analyst time for earnings transcript review by 90% Enabled scalable and consistent client insight generation across 50+ enterprise clients
Increased solution pitch conversion by 25% due to aligned and personalized recommendations.
Cloud Certifications
Microsoft Certification:
1. Azure AI Fundamentals - AI 900 2. Azure AI Engineer Associate - AI102
AWS certification:
1. AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
GCP:
1. GCP Associate Cloud Engineer 2. GCP - Professional Data Engineering 3. GCP - Professional Machine learning Engineer
